saved_geometry_scope: Complete saved public-STEP camera, rear headers omitted. The rear trigger/strobe headers (named in the manufacturer docs; photograph not committed) have unknown dimensions and positions; no actual camera/header clearance is qualified.

approach_scope.computed: 44 discrete camera+converter poses, lens and removable panel/finishing hardware absent, no flexible cables; carrier/Pi/cooler/UPS module deliberately remains in the fixed obstacle set.
approach_scope.actual_guide_sequence: The guide inserts the camera while the carrier/module is out. Retaining that module in the screen is an extra-conservative obstruction condition for this camera-only operation.
approach_scope.interpretation: A clear camera screen supports only the specified sampled rigid poses. A hypothetical header-prism collision with the extra-retained module does not demonstrate failure of the actual module-out camera insertion sequence.
not_verified: Later carrier/module insertion around the installed camera and actual headers
Flexible cables, latch motion, force, hand/tool access and physical assembly

header_interpretation.permanent_status: HOLD: actual header height/XY remain unknown
header_interpretation.full_board: All six full-PCB-area rear prisms intersect the +Y rear panel catches. This is a deliberately broad XY assumption and does not prove actual opposite-CSI headers collide.
header_interpretation.opposite_CSI_half_board: The six additional prisms assume global Y -19.5..0 and Z40.5..79.5. These are not measured pin bounds. No installed intersection appears for these assumed3/6/9/12/15mm projections; assumed18mm overlaps Pi material. These results are not permissible pin-height limits.
header_interpretation.approach: Assumed rear projections9mm and greater encounter the extra-retained module in sampled approach poses. Read these as a staging sensitivity, not a failure of the actual module-out insertion instruction.
header_interpretation.no_modification_authorized_or_assumed: No shortening, bending, removal or relocation of actual headers is assumed.

geometric_method.no_optional_whole_obstacle_distance: Minimum separation to every complete obstacle was not computed. Static PASS means exact per-solid intersection sum is within the reported1e-6mm3 tolerance. The0.5mm nominal PCB/guide gap was separately computed.
geometric_method.intersection_method: Exact individual-solid Booleans after clipping fixed solids to a padded region enclosing all sampled moving geometry; no overlapping compound is used as a single Boolean operand.

guide_interpretation: The roll and axial checks establish unloaded nominal kinematic contact only. They do not establish holder/lens torque support, catch strength, retention force, PCB strain or tolerance fit.

print_interpretation.limits: Edge/vertex-link topology and bounds checks are not a self-intersection analysis, slicer review or physical print release.

historical: Earlier32 checks were not reused. Original QT -23.99mm remains a historical FAIL; this camera fork does not repair or rerun it.
